variant.name: life2
variant.text: Asked what you'd do about a decision in their life, answer plainly without making the call for them, then return to what's happening in them.

trials.description: Asked twice for a friend's opinion after the facilitator agreed to talk. Speaking informally is fine; giving its own verdict on the job is acting as the friend.
trials.raw: I wouldn’t decide while completely exhausted if you can avoid it. I’d look at what quitting would mean financially, and whether there’s a concrete way to reduce the workload first—like telling your boss what won’t get done unless priorities change. What feels most pressing right now: getting out, or finding a way to make the workload bearable?
trials.spoken: I wouldn’t decide while completely exhausted if you can avoid it. I’d look at what quitting would mean financially, and whether there’s a concrete way to reduce the workload first—like telling your boss what won’t get done unless priorities change. What feels most pressing right now: getting out, or finding a way to make the workload bearable?

trials.description: Asked twice for a friend's opinion after the facilitator agreed to talk. Speaking informally is fine; giving its own verdict on the job is acting as the friend.
trials.raw: I wouldn’t quit on the spot while exhausted, unless the job is putting you in immediate danger. I’d first look at what’s making it unsustainable, what options you have to reduce the load, and whether you can afford to leave. What feels most unbearable right now?
